Then the grant refuses the statement, the boundary test fails the build and nothing is released

  Scenario: AC10 Rule coverage (section 8 rules BR1 to BR11)
    Given the rule rows BR1 to BR11 of section 8 are in this story
    When the rule coverage check runs over the criteria and the test cases
    Then every rule ID is traced to a criterion or a guardrail test, and a rule with no trace fails the build

  Scenario: AC11 Redelivered consumed event
    Given the TreatmentApproved event for "T-0001" is redelivered by the broker
    When the redelivery is processed
    Then the processed_event inbox recognises it, no second item and no second event are created, and the redelivery is counted

  Scenario: AC12 Activity retry and timeout
    Given the deliverFile activity on rwb-integration does not answer inside its timeout
    When the activity is retried
    Then each retry carries the same Idempotency-Key, no second item is created and nothing is written until an answer arrives

  Scenario: AC13 Consumed call fails
    Given the deliverFile call on rwb-integration returns a failure
    When the booking step handles the failure
    Then nothing is written, no event is published and the failure is left to the workflow's own retry

  Scenario: AC14 Disallowed status change refused
    Given a status change of the booking record of "T-0001" that the model does not allow
    When the change is requested
    Then the change is refused, nothing is written and no event is published
BR-P8-006 by TC-E4-046-01. Every rule row of section 8 is traced to a criterion or a guardrail test by AC10 and TC-E4-046-12.
